text: After the party. <break time="0.8s" /> Ichabod stayed behind. <break time="0.8s" /> To talk with Katrina. <break time="0.8s" /> Hoping that she would say yes to him. <break time="0.8s" /> Nobody knows what she said. <break time="0.8s" /> But he soon came out. <break time="0.8s" /> Looking very sad. <break time="0.8s" /> And went straight to the stable. <break time="0.8s" /> It was the hour. <break time="0.8s" /> When ghosts are said to walk. <break time="0.8s" /> And all the stories. <break time="0.8s" /> Came back to his mind. <break time="0.8s" /> Riding past a huge old tree. <break time="0.8s" /> He heard a groan. <break time="0.8s" /> But it was only the branches. <break time="0.8s" /> Rubbing together. <break time="0.8s" /> Near a dark stream. <break time="0.8s" /> Gunpowder suddenly stopped. <break time="0.8s" /> And Ichabod saw a huge black shape. <break time="0.8s" /> Standing among the trees. <break time="0.8s" /> Who are you. <break time="0.8s" /> He called in a shaking voice. <break time="0.8s" /> But the rider did not answer. <break time="0.8s" /> The stranger. <break time="0.8s" /> Riding a powerful black horse. <break time="0.8s" /> Silently kept pace with Ichabod. <break time="0.8s" /> On the dark road. <break time="0.8s" /> Then, against the night sky. <break time="0.8s" /> Ichabod saw with horror. <break time="0.8s" /> That the rider had no head. <break time="0.8s" /> On his shoulders. <break time="0.8s" /> His fear grew. <break time="0.8s" /> When he saw the head itself. <break time="0.8s" /> Sitting on the front. <break time="0.8s" /> Of the riders saddle. <break time="0.8s" /> Ichabod kicked Gunpowder. <break time="0.8s" /> And the two horses raced. <break time="0.8s" /> Through the dark. <break time="0.8s" /> Stones flying under their hooves.
